attachments.origin_landmark: perioral modiolus fibers, drawn in part from the buccinator and other perioral muscles converging at the modiolus

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Unlike most named muscles, has no true bony origin at all -- it is composed largely of fibers from other perioral muscles (buccinator and others) that converge and interdigitate at the modiolus, a fibromuscular node lateral to the mouth.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
